name: 720W N-Type Bifacial Dual-Glass Solar Module
tagline: More Power for High-Capacity Solar Projects. The Callsun CN720W combines high-power N-type cells, bifacial energy generation, and a durable dual-glass structure in a module engineered for utility-scale, commercial, and large distributed solar projects. With up to 720W of front-side power and 23.18% module efficiency, it helps increase installed capacity while supporting efficient system design and long-term energy generation.
tech: N-type bifacial monocrystalline silicon (210×105mm wafer) · 132 half-cut cells (6×11×2) · 2.0+2.0mm dual-glass construction · IP68 junction box with 3 bypass diodes · Fire Class C · 1500V DC max system voltage
imageAlt: Callsun CN720W N-Type bifacial dual-glass 720W solar module front view on white background with visible half-cut cell grid and anodized aluminum frame
description: The Callsun CN720W is an N-type bifacial dual-glass module designed for projects that require higher installed capacity, reliable electrical performance, and long-term durability. Its 132-cell architecture built on 210mm wafers delivers up to 720W of rated power, while the bifacial design allows the rear side to capture reflected and diffused light for additional energy generation under suitable installation conditions. The 2.0 mm front and rear heat-strengthened glass construction provides balanced protection for the cells, helping the module withstand long-term outdoor exposure and demanding operating environments. Built for B2B distributors, EPC installers and utility-scale IPPs who need maximum power density, IEC-certified supply and a 30-year linear power warranty.

specs.label: Output Commitment
specs.value: 87.4% output at year 30 (1% first-year + linear degradation thereafter)

benefits.title: N-Type Cell Technology
benefits.description: N-type monocrystalline cells offer lower light-induced degradation and better low-light response, helping the module maintain stable energy generation throughout its operating life. Lower degradation and reliable power generation over the full 30-year module lifetime translate directly into more bankable long-term yield for project developers and asset owners.

benefits.title: Bifacial Energy Gain
benefits.description: The bifacial cell architecture generates electricity from both the front and rear sides of the module. When installed above reflective surfaces or in optimized system configurations, rear-side irradiance can contribute additional energy yield. With a bifaciality factor of 80% ± 5%, the CN720W is designed to make better use of available sunlight across a wider range of project environments—supporting additional energy generation in optimized installations.

benefits.title: 720W High-Power Output
benefits.description: Delivering up to 720W of rated output with 23.18% module efficiency, the CN720W enables more installed capacity per module. Its high-power design can help reduce the number of modules required for a target system capacity, potentially simplifying array layout, mounting structure requirements, cabling, and installation planning—so higher power per module supports efficient system design and project deployment.

benefits.title: Durable Dual-Glass Structure
benefits.description: The CN720W features 2.0 mm AR-coated heat-strengthened front glass and 2.0 mm heat-strengthened rear glass. The symmetrical dual-glass construction provides enhanced protection against moisture ingress, mechanical stress, and long-term environmental exposure, while supporting stable performance throughout the module lifecycle. Balanced 2.0 mm front and rear heat-strengthened glass provides long-term cell protection.

benefits.title: Designed for 1500V PV Systems
benefits.description: With a maximum system voltage of 1500V and a maximum series fuse rating of 35A, the CN720W is designed to support modern high-capacity PV system architectures. An IP68-rated junction box, three bypass diodes, and an anodized aluminum alloy frame provide the electrical protection and structural reliability required for professional project deployment—engineered for utility-scale and commercial solar applications.

benefits.title: Wide Operating Temperature Range
benefits.description: The CN720W is designed to operate across a temperature range of -40°C to +85°C. Its N-type cells, dual-glass construction, IP68-rated junction box, and anodized aluminum frame work together to support stable operation across a wide range of outdoor project environments—from arid desert climates to cold high-altitude installations, delivering reliable performance across demanding operating conditions.
